qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the safety bolt on body, except for B-pillar?
What torque value should be used for safety bolts on B-pillar?
What is the torque specification for screws used for seatbelt height adjustment on body?
How much torque should be applied when installing the seat belt to seat on E31 models?
What is the difference in torque between safety bolts on B-pillar and safety bolts on body?
qa_pairs.answer: Safety bolts on body require 48 Nm while B-pillar safety bolts require 31 Nm, a difference of 17 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What torque specification applies to seat belt to backrest on E31 models?
What is the torque value for headrest to backrest attachment on E31?
Which components require the highest torque specification according to this table?
qa_pairs.answer: Safety bolt on body (except for B-pillar) and safety bolt on seat/touring rear seat backrest both require 48 Nm
